title: Refund of Credit Service Fees — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
Desk rule note: service fees charged in connection with Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers are extension fees, reinstatement fees and telephone redemption fees.

**Rule.** A credit service fee is refunded in full when it was charged in error. A fee is charged in error in any of these cases:
- a fee charged although the customer's Summit tier waives it;
- a telephone fee on an instrument that cannot be redeemed online;
- a fee for an extension or reinstatement that was not granted.

**Once only.** Each fee entry can be refunded at most once. The evidence is whether a fee refund entry already stands against that fee entry.

**Granted service.** A fee for an extension or reinstatement that was granted is never refunded, even if the credit is later unused.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Fee entry on the credit | Refund |
|---|---|
| Extension fee of 99.00 charged to a customer whose Summit tier waives credit service fees | Refunded in full, 99.00 |
| Telephone redemption fee on an instrument that cannot be redeemed online | Refunded in full |
| Reinstatement fee charged, reinstatement not granted | Refunded in full |
| Extension fee charged, extension granted, credit never used afterward | Not refunded |
| Fee entry that already has a fee refund entry against it | Not refunded a second time |
